observations: Photo 0: A white plastic tank enclosed in a grey metal cage (classic IBC tote/intermediate bulk container) sitting on a pallet-style base, with a blue plastic valve/tap at the bottom front.
Photo 1: Closer view of the same type of tote, showing a red warning/hazard sticker on the plastic body and the metal cage with some surface wear; another tote visible behind it.
Photo 2: Close-up of embossed lettering on the plastic body, partially legible as '...1000...' and '250...L...' along with other worn digits, suggesting a capacity marking but not fully readable.
Multiple totes appear stacked/grouped in the background across photos, suggesting this may be sold individually from a group of similar used units.
No manufacturer brand name, logo, or model plate is clearly readable in any photo.
Metal cage shows some discoloration/light surface rust in photo 1; plastic shows scuffs and dirt consistent with prior industrial use.

identity.kind: IBC tote (intermediate bulk container) - plastic tank in metal cage, with bottom valve, for liquid storage

claims.claim: To store industrial liquids or hazardous chemicals
claims.evidence: This describes intended use, not a provable condition; no certification, test, or compliance plate is visible in any photo to confirm the tank is rated or safe for hazardous chemical storage.

risks.risk: Bottom valve/tap may be cracked, stuck, or leaking.
risks.proof: A close-up photo or short video of the valve being opened and liquid (e.g. water) flowing freely without leaks at the seams.
risks.if_unproven: priced as non-functional / needing valve replacement

risks.risk: Plastic tank may have hairline cracks, UV embrittlement, or past chemical residue/contamination not visible at this angle.
risks.proof: Full walk-around photos of all four sides and the base, plus a photo of the inside through the top opening.
risks.if_unproven: priced as condition-unknown / possible contamination, lowering value to a used, unverified-safety container

risks.risk: Actual capacity is unclear since the embossed marking in photo 2 is only partially legible.
risks.proof: A clear, well-lit close-up of the full capacity/manufacture plate showing liters and date of manufacture.
risks.if_unproven: priced at the smaller plausible capacity read (around 1000L cage-standard) until confirmed

risks.risk: Metal cage may have rust/corrosion compromising structural support for a full liquid load.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all cage joints and welds, especially the base corners.
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetic-rust / reduced structural confidence

risks.risk: Unknown prior contents could mean hazardous residue, which matters for buyer's intended reuse.
risks.proof: Seller statement or label showing last stored substance, or a photo of any hazard/chemical label still on the tote.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown-residue / requires buyer-side cleaning before reuse

proof_requests: Clear, well-lit photo of the full capacity/manufacture plate (the embossed numbers in photo 2).
Video of the bottom valve being opened and water flowing through without leaks.
Full exterior walk-around photos (all 4 sides + base) showing no cracks.
Photo looking inside the top opening to check for residue or damage.
Any chemical/hazard label or seller disclosure of what was last stored inside.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable by type as a used IBC tote/industrial liquid storage container, so it can be priced at its worst case (unverified valve function, unknown prior contents, unconfirmed capacity) pending the listed proofs.
